reference: deployed 4B policy at R=0.75%, 4 slots, same data/costs; every candidate is compared with it at the SAME slippage

hypotheses.V: Breakouts whose initial stop is wide (2*ATR / price) have negative expectancy per R in BOTH halves of the data (found by mining the 5y ledger: top stop-width quintile mean R -0.14 train / -0.10 validation). Thresholds are the data-derived quintile edges 4.5% and 5.6%.
hypotheses.T: Losses cluster in recurring chop regimes (four >20% drawdown episodes). A hysteretic equity-drawdown throttle cuts risk in them. Mechanism-based, no thresholds fitted: round numbers chosen before looking.

V1.note: skip new root entries whose signal stop width exceeds 5.6%

T1.note: risk x0.5 once equity is 15% below its peak, restored at 7% below peak

T2.note: risk x0.5 once equity is 20% below peak, restored at 10% below peak

policies: full factorial {none,V1,V2} x {none,T1,T2} = 9 rows incl. the reference; 8 candidates in total. No variant will be added after seeing results.
acceptance_at_2bps_and_5bps: net profit > 0 in H1, H2 and Y2026
full-period Calmar >= reference Calmar + 0.05 AND full-period max DD < reference max DD AND full CAGR >= 30% (2bps) / >= 0.9 x reference CAGR (5bps)
Calmar >= reference Calmar in BOTH H1 and H2 (improvement must not come from one half)
tie_break: simplest accepted candidate (fewest rules), then highest full Calmar
contamination_disclosure: There is no untouched holdout. Hypothesis V was mined from the full 5y ledger including 2026, and earlier ablation/diagnostics also saw 2026. Acceptance here is in-sample evidence only. The live bot will NOT be changed from this experiment without the user's explicit confirmation; the only clean test is forward paper trading.
multiple_testing: 8 candidates x 2 slippage levels; the +0.05 Calmar margin and the both-halves rule are the only protection.
